blocks.text: The western basalt plains grasslands are one of Australia's most threatened ecosystems. Iramoo Wildflower Grassland is a remnant of this ancient landscape — a living archive of plants, soils and stories that have shaped this Country for millennia.
The GREEN Lab has strong links to the three grasslands that are managed by the Cairnlea Conservation Reserves Committee of Management:
These reserves are part of the Jones Creek Grassland Corridor [MO1.1]that also includes a range of protected and unprotected remnant native grasslands, including:

Howardsons Circuit Grassland (Brimbank City Council)
Reconciliation Rocks Grassland (Victoria University)
VU grassland (Victoria University)
Jonesfield Corner (private ownership)
Section G grassland (State of Victoria)
Denton Avenue Grassland (Brimbank City Council)
